eyebrow: Azure runs the control plane, you run the node pools
caption: Azure's own architecture diagram: a managed control plane, with customer-managed node pools running the actual Pods.

eyebrow: Three commands to a running cluster
code:
az group create --name northbridge-rg --location eastus

az aks create \
  --resource-group northbridge-rg \
  --name northbridge-aks \
  --node-count 3 --generate-ssh-keys

az aks get-credentials \
  --resource-group northbridge-rg \
  --name northbridge-aks
caption: get-credentials writes into your local kubeconfig — kubectl works exactly like it does everywhere else in this course.
